about: Echo's starter set: the contours its melody calls are made from, by level. Each id is a contour in contourLibrary.json (its values, 0-based). A level's calls draw on its own contours and every earlier level's. Prune or add here; the tests check every id is in the library, at its level's tier, and inside the pad window at its level's zero points.

padWindow.about: Scale positions from the 1 (0): the 5 below it (-3) up to the 7 (6), ten pads. Every call stays inside it.

rules: Level 1 is Tier 1 common, Level 2 is Tier 2 common, Level 3 is Tier 3 (all uncommon or rare there; uncommon chosen).
About 12 a level: four of 3 notes, five of 4, three of 5.
Every motion at each level: rising, falling, arch, valley, and a repeated note (a wave too from Level 2). The motion is the contour's own (echo/contours.ts contourMotion).
Inside the pad window at every zero point of its level: Level 1's at 1 only (values -3 to 6), Level 2's and Level 3's at 1, 3 and 5 (values -3 to 2, as the 5 adds 4).
Level 1 keeps to the 5 below the 1 up to the 5 above it (values -3 to 4), an octave of pads.
Singable shapes over clever ones: home (the 0) at the start or the end where the tier offers it.
